identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) educational institution: 'University Of La Verne', La Verne, CA, EIN 95-1644026 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer)

OUSD Board minutes (Feb 25, 2026, File 26-0265) describe the 'University of La Verne' in this MOU as a private, nonprofit university in California, for teacher-credential intern and practica programs, matching ULV's credential programs and the agenda's Talent/Human Resources office
Wikipedia describes the University of La Verne as a private university in La Verne, California with a College of Education, consistent with a teacher-credential partnership
research.notes: Official site laverne.edu blocks automated fetching (Cloudflare 403), so phone, email and address were not verified from it and are left null. Website taken from Wikipedia infobox. profile.summary: The University of La Verne is a private, nonprofit university in La Verne, California. It awards undergraduate, graduate and doctoral degrees through its colleges, including a College of Education, and it operates regional campuses across California.

review.notes: The agenda names 'University of La Verne' for a Talent/HR MOU, which fits the single private nonprofit university in La Verne, CA with a College of Education. ProPublica (EIN 95-1644026, 501(c)(3)) and Wikipedia support the legal name, type, headquarters, website and the neutral summary; I could not independently retrieve the cited OUSD minutes, but the name is distinctive and the services fit.
